name: Old junior: request exit of all shares (from the hardware wallet)

steps.title: requestExit(all 79.999999999999 shares) on old junior
steps.what: Locks your 80 shares in the old junior for exit. Notice runs to 28 Nov 00:00 UTC; the exit is priced at the first settle after that (Sun 29 Nov 21:41 UTC) and claimed then.
